conviction_note: Nothing found decides this print: no resultatvarsel, no pre-release, no Q3 consensus reachable, so p_up stays 50 and the scaled number is 0; abs_move is set at 6.5 because Q3 numbers are entirely new on a 6-analyst, $1.6m/day name whose last two prints moved -6.3% and +10.5% on small EBITDA surprises against consensus. findings.finding: NOK strengthened further in Q3: average SEK/NOK fell 7.2% y/y (1.060 to 0.984), EUR/NOK 7.3% and DKK/NOK 7.4%, against 5.5-6.2% in Q2 when the translation gap was already 4pp on revenue (3% reported vs 7% curr-adj); with ~53% of revenue outside Norway, reported Q3 growth loses roughly 4pp, slightly more than in Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 printed +3% reported / +7% curr-adj revenue and the stock rose 10.5% on an EBITDA beat, so the market has looked through translation when the curr-adj line was strong.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: FX is public and six analysts model it. The residual is that reported-number headlines (TDN 'ventet' comparisons) can still read soft if consensus lagged the September NOK move (SEK/NOK 0.96 in September alone).
findings.independence: The company's own Q2 report quantifies the translation gap: https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=679780

findings.finding: DNB Asset Management funds sold 125,257 SATS shares on 22 October, taking their holding below 5% (4.95%, from 5.76% at the previous notice), a domestic long-only seller active in the week before the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance of a pre-print flagging to compare; the stock fell 3.0% and 1.6% on 22 and 23 October, so the selling is visible in the tape already.
findings.original_quote: Fond forvaltet av DNB Asset Management AS solgte i går 125 257 aksjer i SATS ASA. Etter dette eier fond forvaltet av DNB Asset Management AS 9 774 762 aksjer i selskapet, noe som utgjør en direkte eierandel på 4,95% (DNB AM funds sold 125,257 SATS shares yesterday, now own 9,774,762 shares, a 4.95% direct stake)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the stock already gave back 4.5% over 22-23 October. What is not priced is whether the seller continues into the print, which an index or flow rebalancing would not signal.

findings.finding: The Aug-2026 buyback (up to NOK 100m) had spent NOK 50.0m by 29 September, buying ~80-95k shares a day (roughly 20-25% of daily volume), and no status has been filed since 30 September, consistent with a pre-results pause; the remaining NOK 50m, plus a balance sheet at 1.1x leverage against a 1.5x floor target, can return as a bid from the release day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell from 42.30 (30 Sep) to 39.50 (5 Oct) in the first days without buyback statuses; prior programmes were announced with results (Aug 2026 with Q2, Feb 2026 NOK 200m with Q4) and those days rose 10.5% and 6.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: The programme is public, but the pause is an inference from the absence of filings and the post-pause bid is not something the tape has reflected; if priced, the early-October dip would not have occurred with no news.
findings.independence: Q2 report: leverage 1.1x vs target 'lower end of the 1.5x to 2.0x range' and 'Excess capital will be returned to shareholders' https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=679780

baseline_tension: Neutral: the run-up (-0.7% 20d, +1.3% 60d) and the truncated-zero short register give no lean, and the findings net to about -0.2, so nothing here cuts against or agrees with the priced lean in a meaningful way.
language_note: The DNB Asset Management flagging was filed in Norwegian only ('Flaggemelding SATS'); the English feed carries the PDF form but the headline and body are Norwegian.

Finansavisen's TDN headlines carry the consensus comparison for past prints (e.g. Q1 'EBITDA 526 ... (VENTET 534)'), which is how the stock's sensitivity to the EBITDA bar was established; no Q3 preview was reachable in either language.
Otherwise nothing the English sources did not already carry: SATS publishes every release in English, with a parallel Norwegian 'Pressemelding'.
lessons_applied: abs_move_pct raised from 5.5 to 6.5: the period is not pre-released ('numbers new' base ~7%), the name sits in the thin 3-7 analyst band, and the last two prints moved 6.3% and 10.5%; uncertainty about sign stays in p_up, not the size.

Findings unchanged: the FX finding was already sized as macro-to-company transmission, the flagging as positioning already partly in the tape, and the buyback as an inference; no lesson moved any of them a second time.
